tricks.concept: गति का परिचय और सापेक्ष गति
tricks.trick: R-O-M: Relative to Observer — Motion. 'किसके हिसाब से?' पूछो, फिर बताओ गति है या नहीं।
O-D-D: Origin + Distance + Direction. तीनों मिलकर position complete।

tricks.concept: सरल रेखीय गति – दूरी और विस्थापन
tricks.trick: D-Path, Disp-Short: Distance = path length; Displacement = shortest (start→end).
U-E-E: Uniform = Equal distance in Equal time.
S-by-T: Speed = Distance by Time. Average = Total distance by Total time.
V-D: Velocity needs Direction. Speed नहीं, Displacement/time = average velocity.
A-VUT: Acceleration = Velocity change Upon Time — a = (v−u)/t.
